normal.name: Mx. Luna Corbden 🪿🐸
normal.text: Why does World of Horror punish you for saving to exit and then come back? I don't want the game to be easier. I'm not trying to savescum. I know survival rougelikes are meant to be hard. I just want to be able to quit in the middle of a run and then start back up just how it was. Instead it de-equips everything (tedious) and you seem to lose stats, followers, and apartment items. This is a simple accessibility issue. I simply can't focus for a full 1-2 hour run. It's harmful for me to continue when I'm IRL fatigued. #gaming #MECFS
